name: Fathom
one_liner: Fathom is an AI meeting recorder/notetaker that transcribes, summarizes, and extracts action items from video calls, exposing a public REST API for meetings, recordings, transcripts, summaries, and webhooks.

evidence.quote: Anyone can browse the API docs and start building
API keys are created at the user level. Your key can access meetings recorded by you or shared to your Team.
All REST API resources are authenticated with API keys generated via the Fathom website's settings area.
Build a Fathom integration that other users can install.
Fathom now offers an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, allowing you to connect your Fathom meeting data to AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and more.
users can make 60 calls per minute across all of their API keys; this ensures system stability and reliability

notes: Official docs live at developers.fathom.ai (Fathom's dedicated API domain), separate from the consumer app at fathom.video. API key access is self-serve and free (generated from account Settings > API Access, no plan gate or approval mentioned in docs). OAuth2 is documented as the path for multi-tenant/marketplace apps installed by other users, alongside per-user API keys for single-workspace/internal use. Vendor-hosted official MCP server exists at api.fathom.ai/mcp using OAuth-based user authorization; exact OAuth scope/flow details and total endpoint count could not be confirmed within fetch budget (authentication sub-page 404'd), and api_breadth is estimated as small based on the handful of named resources (meetings, recordings summary/transcript, webhooks) — lowering confidence slightly for auth_methods completeness.
